papers.summary: Spectral Weight Decay применяет decoupled nuclear-norm update вместо обычного равномерного weight decay. Метод снижает effective rank, улучшает SVD-компрессию и устойчивость к label noise.
papers.relevance: Наиболее прямое совпадение с интересами к spectral regularization, effective rank, compressibility и memorization under label noise.

evidence.quote: The additive shrinkage acts more strongly on smaller singular values and concentrates the spectrum.
At 500 M and a 4% distortion budget, it reaches 1.89× compression and a 1.18× GPU inference speedup.
At 60% label noise, mean clean-test accuracy gains over matched ℓ2 regularization reach 17.78 points on MNIST and 4.59 points on four BERT-base tasks.

papers.title: Spectral Weight Decay: Inducing Low-Rank Structure in Neural Network Weights

papers.summary: sMuon аппроксимирует Muon в низкоранговом пространстве LoRA с использованием matmul-only реализации. В SFT метод сравнивается с AdamW, per-factor Muon, LoRA-Muon и Riemannion, а в ReLoRA достигает наименьшего validation loss вместе с Riemannion.
papers.relevance: Прямо относится к оптимизации LoRA, геометрии low-rank updates, Muon и компромиссам качества и вычислительных затрат.

evidence.quote: By relying entirely on matrix multiplications, we are able to avoid the overhead from QR and SVD.
In the ReLoRA pretraining setting, we illustrate that Muon LoRA methods are generally stronger than AdamW LoRA.
Specifically we find that our method attains the lowest final validation loss, tying with Riemannion, but being ∼30% faster.

papers.title: Approximate Muon with low-rank adapters

papers.summary: NoRA нормализует down-projection LoRA вдоль rank dimension. Доступны два режима: постоянная нормализация во время обучения и NoRA-init с нормализацией только при инициализации. Эксперименты охватывают pretraining, SFT и RLVR.
papers.relevance: Сильно соответствует интересам к стабильности и геометрии LoRA, convergence и parameter-efficient fine-tuning без дополнительных параметров или inference overhead.

evidence.quote: NoRA continuously normalizes the down-projection matrix A along the low-rank dimension r throughout training.
NoRA-init normalizes A only once at initialization and subsequently optimizes it without constraints during training.
These benefits require neither additional trainable parameters nor inference-time computation.
We conduct experiments across pretraining, supervised finetuning, and reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Normalized Low-Rank Adaptation

papers.summary: Context Language Models позволяют модели самостоятельно управлять контекстом, представляя его как файл, который модель может обновлять. Работа сообщает улучшения accuracy и снижение FLOPs на задачах context management и multi-agent systems.
papers.relevance: Наиболее близкая работа к цели построения research-digest agent с explicit context management и application-controlled orchestration.

evidence.quote: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context.
We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file.
11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus

papers.title: Context Language Models

papers.summary: Это обзор reasoning-search систем, организующий их по retrieval coupling, controller design, knowledge source и grounding strictness. Он рассматривает циклы планирования, поиска, интеграции, проверки и остановки.
papers.relevance: Полезен непосредственно для архитектуры digest agent, особенно для paper retrieval, verification, relevance ranking и stopping policy.

evidence.quote: Recent work addresses these limitations by tightly coupling step-by-step reasoning with interactive search, treating retrieval as an action within an iterative agentic loop rather than a one-shot preprocessing step.
We analyze these systems through four architectural axes: retrieval coupling, controller design, knowledge source, and grounding strictness.
